Navigation

Navigasi Udara Taktis

A military navigation system (TACAN) providing bearing and distance information to aircraft, functionally similar to VOR/DME but used mainly for military operations.

Why it matters

Navigasi Udara Taktis matters because it supports clear communication in Navigation contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Questions and answers

What is Navigasi Udara Taktis?

In this glossary, Navigasi Udara Taktis refers to: A military navigation system (TACAN) providing bearing and distance information to aircraft, functionally similar to VOR/DME but used mainly for military operations.

How is Navigasi Udara Taktis used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Lanjutkan langsung ke stasiun TACAN Alpha, tunggu vektor untuk pendekatan akhir."

Navigasi Udara Taktis matters because it supports clear communication in Navigation contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Definition

A military navigation system (TACAN) providing bearing and distance information to aircraft, functionally similar to VOR/DME but used mainly for military operations.

Operational example

Proceed direct to TACAN station Alpha, expect vectors for final approach.
